result.topic_en: A heavily revised Latin draft on the boundary values of a function of a complex quantity q given by a power series inside the unit circle (via an Abel-type limit theorem), followed by the notation (x) and E(x) and a calculation of formula 62, an integral of logarithmic terms expressed as a series in log 4 cos^2(nx/2).

methods.what: Abel's limit theorem: a convergent power series is the radial limit of its sum as r tends to 1
methods.quote:
$a_0+a_1r+a_2r^2\ldots$
[-expressa-], convergente $r$ [-ad-] versus limitem 1, convergit versus valorem
eundem.

methods.what: Extension to complex q: the boundary series, if convergent, equals the limit of f(q) as q approaches q_0 along a straight line normal to the boundary
methods.quote:
Si functio $f(q)$ complexae quantitatis q exhibeatur per seriem,
$a_0+a_1q+a_2q^2\ldots$

methods.what: Definition of (x) as the signed distance from x to the nearest integer, set to 0 at half-integers
methods.quote: Sit brevitatis gratia (x) {+aut, si+} quantitas absolute minima

methods.what: Definition of E(x) as the greatest integer not exceeding x (floor function)
methods.quote: $E(x)$ numerus integer maximus non major quam x

methods.what: Evaluation of the integral of (log k dq/q - log 4 sqrt q) dq/q at q_0=e^{xi} as a series in log 4cos^2(nx/2) plus sawtooth terms

items.quote: Quamobrem [-Has-] {+in diversis[?]+} nisi hos tantum valores functionum propositarum {+in series evolutarum+} hic respicimus
items.english: Therefore we consider here only these values of the proposed functions expanded in series

items.quote:
Si functio $f(q)$ complexae quantitatis q exhibeatur per seriem,
$a_0+a_1q+a_2q^2\ldots$
items.english: If a function f(q) of the complex quantity q is given by a power series, then the series, if it has a sum on the boundary, expresses the limit value of f(q) as q approaches q_0 along a line normal to the boundary of the region.
